evidence.note: Unifies text-based and visually-grounded reasoning in one vision-language model and uses RL with a mode-relative advantage to make the model pick which mode to use per input, raising average accuracy over eight benchmarks by about 5 points.
evidence.title: Mixture-of-Visual-Thoughts: Exploring Context-Adaptive Reasoning Mode Selection for General Visual Reasoning

evidence.note: ARES trains multimodal reasoning models to spend exploration effort in proportion to problem difficulty, using sliding-window token entropy as the signal for when and how much to explore.
evidence.title: ARES: Multimodal Adaptive Reasoning via Difficulty-Aware Token-Level Entropy Shaping

evidence.note: Heima replaces each stage of a multimodal model's textual chain of thought with a single learned 'thinking token' generated in latent space, and trains a separate decoder that can expand those tokens back into readable reasoning.
evidence.title: Efficient Reasoning with Hidden Thinking

evidence.note: HiDrop prunes about 90% of the vision tokens in a multimodal LLM by injecting them only at the layer where visual-text fusion actually begins and then dropping them on a concave schedule with a per-layer early exit, matching baseline accuracy while training 1.72x faster.
evidence.title: HiDrop: Hierarchical Vision Token Reduction in MLLMs via Late Injection, Concave Pyramid Pruning, and Early Exit
